sessionStart.powershell: $exitCode = 1; $payload = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $temp = [IO.Path]::GetTempFileName(); try { [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($temp, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload)); curl.exe --fail --silent --show-error --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --request POST --data-binary "@$temp" http://127.0.0.1:43877/copilot/hooks/sessionStart; $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit $exitCode
